description: Design a database schema with DDD aggregate mapping for PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB. Supports SQL DDL and Prisma output formats. If fields are omitted, smart inference suggests common fields based on the aggregate name.

existingModels.description: Names of existing models in your schema — used to auto-suggest relations

fields.description: Field definitions (name:type format, e.g., 'title:string', 'price:number'). If omitted, fields are inferred from aggregate name.

withSoftDelete.description: Add deleted_at for soft deletes (default: false)

name: design_schema
